learning_outcomes.text: Explain the building blocks of DeFi and how they compose
Describe automated market makers and liquidity provision
Reason about lending, borrowing, collateral and liquidation
Explain stablecoin designs and their failure modes
Identify DeFi-specific risks including oracle, impermanent-loss and smart-contract risk
Evaluate a DeFi protocol's risk profile before using it

integrative_case: A treasury team wants to earn yield on idle stablecoins across DeFi lending and liquidity pools; map the protocols and their composition, quantify impermanent-loss, liquidation and oracle risk, and produce a go/no-go risk memo.
